canonical_topic: Valuing Electricity Storage as a Series of Futures Purchases
definition: A valuation approach for storage where the nightly (off-peak) purchase decision is not discretionary — it always occurs — so the investment can be valued similarly to holding a stream of futures purchases rather than modeling a daily operating decision.
core_idea: When storage always charges overnight with no real operating decision involved, its value can be estimated by forecasting forward prices and valuing the position like a futures purchase, which the author describes as requiring relatively simple math.
key_points: Applies specifically when there is no discretionary daily operating decision — the nightly purchase always happens.
Requires forecasting forward prices into the future.
Described by the author as needing only 'limited mathematics' compared to other approaches.
trading_implications: This method sidesteps the need to model optimal daily charge/discharge behavior when the charging pattern is fixed.
